body: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown strong performance on table question answering, yet their accuracy often degrades as table size increases. We find that this degradation is not uniform across question types. Localization-sensitive questions are particularly affected by irrelevant table content, while questions requiring broader evidence may still benefit from full-table reasoning. Based on this observation, we propose a question-adaptive framework that dynamically selects between localized and full-table reasoning. The framework constructs question-specific sub-tables through operation-aware table decomposition and uses the predicted question type to determine the appropriate reasoning mode. We further introduce silver reference sub-tables for evaluating evidence selection and construct SLQA, a benchmark based on real-world long tables. Experiments on WikiTQ and SLQA show that localization is particularly effective for lookup and local reasoning questions, while adaptive selection between localized and full-table reasoning achieves the best overall performance. These results highlight that long-table QA requires deciding not only how to localize, but also when to localize. Our code and datasets will be made available upon publication of the paper.
summaryZh: 大语言模型在表格问答中的准确率常随着表格规模扩大而下降。本文发现定位敏感型问题更容易受到无关表格内容的影响。为此，提出了一种问题自适应框架，通过操作感知将长表分解为子表，并根据预测的问题类型在局部推理和全表推理之间动态切换。在WikiTQ和新构建的SLQA长表基准上的实验表明，该方法显著提升了长表问答的整体性能。

glossary.explanationZh: 让大模型理解结构化表格数据并准确回答相关自然语言问题的技术任务。
在处理大型结构化数据时，动态筛选出与当前问题直接相关的子区域的操作。
根据问答所需的操作类型，对大型表格进行结构化拆分的方法。
